items.question: Where does the radiance situated in the throat cavity attain absorption?
premises: A radiance is situated in the throat cavity.
The absorption occurs in the brahma aperture.
items.inference: The radiance located in the throat cavity reaches dissolution in the brahma aperture.
uncertainties: The feminine gender of gatā suggests an implied feminine subject not explicitly named in this verse.
items.plain_english: The radiance situated in the throat cavity has gone to absorption in the brahma aperture.
